root.label: IRS posts draft 2026 Form 1040 citizenship question

events.label: IRS posts draft 2026 Form 1040 citizenship question

slots.name: draft release date
slots.sentence: The IRS posted its draft 1040 form for 2026 in late August, which includes the question, "At the time you file your return, are you, and your spouse if filing jointly, a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, or an alien lawfully authorized to work in the U.S.?"
